title: Terms on Which Grain Leaves a Licensed House Under a Storage Agreement
content:
Grain leaves store on a released load-out order and never on a telephone call alone. These are the terms on which an order is taken and worked under Grain Storage and Conditioning Agreements.

## Terms

1. A signed load-out request naming the bushels is registered with the elevator before the order is released, and the request is worked only after the programme's notice in business days has passed, counting days the elevator's scale is open and not counting the day the request was registered.

2. An order must name at least the programme's load-out minimum, and it is worked only against bushels free to move, so pledged bushels are cut from the order rather than the order being refused outright.

3. Each truck loaded carries the programme's truck fee and elevation out is charged on the bushels moved.

4. A load-out taken outside the posted load-out hours carries the programme's out-of-schedule fee on top, charged once per order and not per truck.

5. Where the order empties the agreement it closes on completion, and where bushels remain the agreement returns to active and billing carries on.

6. Outstanding storage charges are settled before or at load-out, and where the member has no settlement to draw on the charges are invoiced to them, since the elevator does not release grain against unpaid storage on programmes that do not settle from grain proceeds.

## The request behind the order

The request the order rests on is the signed one the cooperative holds on its own records for that agreement, identified by the request itself and by the bushels it names, and it stands there before the order is released rather than being taken as the order is worked. The member's account of what they asked for is not the test; the registered request is.

## Counting the notice

The notice runs in business days, which are days the elevator's scale is open. The day the request was registered is not counted. On a programme posting two business days of notice, a request registered on a Monday with the scale open Tuesday and Wednesday is workable on the Wednesday, the Monday not counting and the two open days having passed.

## What happens to an order larger than the free bushels

| What the order names | What the elevator does |
| --- | --- |
| less than the programme's load-out minimum | the order does not reach the minimum an order must name |
| more than the bushels free to move | the pledged bushels are cut from the order, and the order is worked for the rest |
| within the bushels free to move | the order is worked as it stands |

## What the agreement does afterwards

| What is left in store when the order finishes | The agreement |
| --- | --- |
| nothing | closes on completion |
| bushels still on hand | returns to active, and billing carries on |
